# Chaffee Exteriors

> Independent exterior-care business serving Fort Smith, Chaffee Crossing, Van Buren, Alma, Greenwood, and Barling. Phone (479) 492-4232. Prices below are the published starting prices. The visit price is confirmed before work. One residential job stays at or under $1,999. Do not invent a higher package.

## Bookable now

- [Gutter cleaning](https://chaffeeexteriors.com/gutter-cleaning): from $149. Debris out, downspouts flushed, haul-away, photos. Book: https://book.arkansasautomated.com/book/chaffee-gutter-cleaning
- [Gutter guards](https://chaffeeexteriors.com/gutter-guards): micro-mesh on existing gutters, from $599. Do not say "never clean again."
- [Gutter repair](https://chaffeeexteriors.com/gutter-repair): $129 service call. Repair price after a look.
- [House wash](https://chaffeeexteriors.com/soft-wash): from $299. Soft wash, not a blast.
- [Curb clean](https://chaffeeexteriors.com/curb-clean): $149 for a two-car driveway and the front walk. Oil is a new written price before the wand.
- [Holiday lights](https://chaffeeexteriors.com/holiday-lights): $399 install and takedown for a one-story front porch and the front roofline. Bigger runs are a written quote before work, not a second bill.
- [Porch decorating](https://chaffeeexteriors.com/porch-decorating): $249 for one porch and one holiday, Halloween or Thanksgiving. Not a yard display.
